architecture: transactional outbox + monotonic Public cursor + targeted Staff/Guest read models
authority: Local remains business authority; Public remains projection/read-model host
delivery: at-least-once, idempotent model writes, contiguous cursor, gap fail-closed + signed full reset
guest_reads: guest order list/status/table context served from internal Public guest_operational projection; no normal Public-to-Local read roundtrip
guest_privacy: raw device/client tokens are not projected; device/tracking SHA-256 ownership hashes only
staff_reads: Hall snapshot/table account, settlement account and active table drafts are Public read-model reads; active drafts are included in table_draft_context; no normal draft-get relay
coherency: Hall/finance projection does not silently omit an account: projection failure keeps the previous coherent Public model and retries; settlement mutations invalidate operations immediately
table_state: pending-only guest session is projected as pending_guest / منتظر تأیید; mixed accounted+pending remains account with pending count
